Pink Party Bus in Scottsdale? Meet the Pink Hummer Limo

Scottsdale Sprinters does not run a pink party bus, and the honest answer to that search is one vehicle: the Pink Hummer Limo, a stretch Hummer limousine seating 18 at $295 per hour on a 4-hour minimum, so a booking starts at $1,180 before tax. It is a limousine, not a bus — a low cabin you sit in rather than an aisle you stand in — and it is the only pink unit in the fleet. If the group needs a bus, the Party Bus (28 Pax) seats 28 at $250 per hour on the same grid.

Last updated: September 18, 2026

Is there a pink party bus in Scottsdale?

Not in this fleet, and we would rather say so on the first line than sell you something else under the name. Scottsdale Sprinters runs one pink vehicle, the Pink Hummer Limo: a stretch Hummer limousine seating 18, at $295 per hour on a 4-hour minimum, so a booking starts at $1,180 before tax. If you pictured a pink coach with a bench down each side, that is not what arrives. What arrives is a limousine: a long, low cabin with handmade custom leather seats, plush and comfortable, in a custom paint colour that is the reason this search exists at all. There is exactly one of it, so it is booked as one vehicle and never as a quantity. If what you are after is the photograph rather than the chassis, the Hummer is the answer and the rest of this page prices it. If you genuinely need a bus — more seats, a stand-up aisle — the alternatives further down price the Party Bus (28 Pax) and the party Sprinters from the same grid.

Pink Hummer Limo or party bus — what is the actual difference?

A limousine is a stretched car. A party bus is built on a bus chassis. The Pink Hummer Limo is the first of those: 18 seats around a low cabin, entered through a passenger door, with the chauffeur behind a partition. The Party Bus (28 Pax) is the second: 28 seats, a stand-up aisle and a coach entrance. The difference shows up in three places. Headroom: you sit in a limousine, you can stand in the bus. Headcount: 18 against 28. Price: $295 per hour against $250 per hour, both on a 4-hour minimum. Neither is an upgrade on the other; they are different rooms, and the comparison guide linked below carries the full version. What this page will not do is call the Hummer a bus to close the gap between what you searched for and what we own.

What does the Pink Hummer Limo cost in Scottsdale?

$295 per hour on a 4-hour minimum, so the starting total before tax is $1,180 — the published hourly rate times that minimum, the whole pricing model. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout and a 50% deposit confirms the vehicle. You reserve the vehicle, not a seat: eight riders and 18 riders pay the same for the same Hummer. At the minimum, $1,180 across 18 seats is about $66 a head before tax — arithmetic for splitting the bill, not a per-person price. Across the celebration class the published rates run $175–$295/hr on the same 4-hour minimum: $700 to start in the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax), $1,000 in the Party Bus (28 Pax), $1,180 in the Pink Hummer Limo. A one-way move is booked instead as a transfer — $650 one way in the Hummer, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, priced from the drive beyond that with the empty return included — and no hour count to estimate. Request a current quote for your date and itinerary.

What is inside the Pink Hummer Limo?

Every item here comes from the vehicle's own catalog record: the cabin carries handmade custom leather seats; wet bar, lit; champagne bar; star lighting; ambient lighting; custom sound system with custom subs; lit speakers; partition from the chauffeur; ambient outside lighting; privacy-tinted windows. That list is the catalog's, not a brochure's, and nothing has been added to make the page read longer. The seating is handmade custom leather seats, plush and comfortable, and the windows are tinted — between them, what a search for the inside of a pink party bus is usually after: a lit cabin you can photograph from within without the street photographing you back. Luggage is the one number we will not guess: the Hummer has a bag count we confirm in writing. Give the bag count with the headcount and the quote answers whether it fits.

Who books the pink limo?

The bachelorette mobile. One of one. Our most popular ride for women, in the catalog's own words. Three occasions carry it, and each has a service page of its own rather than a paragraph here. Bachelorettes come first, and that is the catalog's ranking rather than our guess — the group is usually well inside the 18 seats and the pink exterior is the point. Birthdays are second: same vehicle, same rate, a different reason. Nightlife is third, an evening that moves between stops with the vehicle staying with you for the booked hours instead of being re-summoned each time. Each has its own service page, linked below, and all three are quoted from the same grid — nothing prices differently because of the occasion.

If you want an actual bus: the alternatives we do run

Two shapes, both from the same celebration grid. The Party Bus (28 Pax) is the bus: 28 seats at $250 per hour, $1,000 to start before tax, about $36 a head across every seat. It is the largest celebration unit we list and the only one you can stand up in. The party Sprinters are the middle ground — a limousine cabin on a Sprinter chassis, which is how a group of 13 to 16 usually travels. The Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is $175 per hour for 13, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) $175 per hour for 16, and the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter $250 per hour for 15. None of them is pink. That is the trade: the colour lives on one chassis. If the colour is what the night is for, the Hummer is the booking; if the headcount is, the Party Bus (28 Pax) is. The rate table below prices both.

How many people fit, and what happens if the group is bigger?

The celebration class seats 13 to 28: the Pink Hummer Limo is 18 of that, the Party Bus (28 Pax) is the ceiling at 28, and the party Sprinters fill 13 to 16. Every one of these is a seated count. Nobody rides standing, so the headcount you give is the headcount the vehicle has to seat, and a group of 19 does not fit the Hummer however good the photographs look. The Pink Hummer Limo also cannot be doubled — there is one of it — so a larger party pairs it with a second unit for the overflow rather than replacing it. Give the real headcount when you ask and the reservations team will size it in the quote.

Can we drink on board, and what are the rules?

Arizona's rules for alcohol in a chauffeured vehicle are not ours to summarise loosely, so they have their own page: the Arizona party bus alcohol law guide linked below answers it, and it applies to the Pink Hummer Limo exactly as it applies to the Party Bus (28 Pax). Our own house rules are on the ride rules page. Three carry a fee: $1,500 for smoking or vaping on board, $450 to deep-clean an excessive spill and $450 for a biohazard clean. An added stop on a transfer is $50, and nothing else is added to the base fare.

How do I get a quote and reserve it?

Four steps: pick the vehicle, request a quote with your date and full itinerary, confirm with a 50% deposit, and the balance is charged to the card on file 48 hours before pickup. Every figure here is the published rate card as it stands; your own total comes back in writing before you pay anything. A quote needs the date and start time, the pickup and final drop addresses, the stops between them, the passenger count, the bag count, and how many hours you want the vehicle. Call or text (623) 986-6339, email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, or request a current quote on the pricing page. Name the Pink Hummer Limo if it is the Hummer you want — the quote confirms it by name.
